answer.note: The four ref files are identical and give no file-specific priority, so I picked the refs by reading the code. D (dogwhistle/honest.py) is the best match. Its `_verify_history` (lines 175-195) rejects `prereg_commit == ledger_commit` with "ledger seal must be a separate commit". It also requires `git diff --name-only` between the two commits to equal only the public digest file. I did not check the "two-arm" part of the request. Suggested split of the 60 minutes: honest.py 35 min (verify the checks above and read tests/test_honest.py), study.py 15 min, heldout.py 7 min, visibility.py 3 min. A (study.py) is the second ref. It holds the shared helpers honest.py imports, such as `digest` and `checkpoint`. Its own `verify_history` (line 314) has no equal-commit check and no changed-files check. B (heldout.py) is the same: its `verify_history` (line 343) has neither check. C (visibility.py) is a near-copy of honest.py, but its `_verify_history` (line 191) also has neither check. That makes it a likely gap to flag. I did not run the tests.
